tmp:2506: shokayim — the thighs/legs of the divine stature, symbolizing concealment ("the thigh is hidden"), identified with Esther as counterpart to Mordekhai's hands
tmp:2507: shokin ve-raglin — thighs-and-legs as limbs of the supernal structure built through words of Torah and prayer, the "standing" aspect that elevates fallen sparks from food, drink, and clothing
tmp:2508: the practice of reviewing one's learning 101 times — repetition of received teaching, contrasted with hearing the sage's fresh innovation directly
tmp:2509: remembering what one receives from one's master — retaining the teacher's teaching, likened to ink whose clarity depends on hearing at the moment of innovation
tmp:2510: the black of the eye (pupil, bat ayin) — the dark part of the eye that contracts and encompasses vast objects, symbol of holy tzimtzum/limitation
tmp:2511: Shacharit — the morning prayer instituted by Avraham (Berakhot 26b), linked here to the "blackness" (shacharut) of dawn/Malkhut elevated through kindness
tmp:2512: the devotional practice of hitbodedut — each person speaking privately between himself and his Creator to make the point of wisdom shine and nullify the heart's foreskin
tmp:2513: the imperative to constantly draw oneself toward absolute truth (emet la-amito) — orienting one's descents and openings toward genuine truth so falls become ascents
tmp:2514: guarding oneself from falsehood — avoidance of sheker as the condition for God's providence ("My eyes are on the faithful of the land") and closeness to divine Oneness
tmp:2515: "shemor pitchei fikha" — the verse-phrase 'guard the openings of your mouth' (Micah 7:5), guarding speech in relation to trust and the procreative faculty
tmp:2516: the requirement that a person contract (metzamtzem) the infinite blazing light of his heart's fervor — self-tzimtzum of enthusiasm so divine service becomes possible
tmp:2517: serving God with graduated measure (be-hadragah u-midah) — orderly, measured divine service enabled by contracting the heart's infinite fervor
tmp:2518: the attained capacity to hear melody (neginah) from any person — a rectified state achieved through nightly study of the Oral Torah/Gemara
tmp:2519: conquering one's anger — subduing ka'as, the self-mastery linked to the reward of "a hand and a name" (yad va-shem) for keeping the Sabbaths
tmp:2520: many mitzvot — a multitude of commandments performed, related to joy pervading the full stature of 248 limbs and 365 sinews
tmp:2521: departing from nature (tiv'iyut) — transcending the natural order into divine providence (hashgachah), the totality of holiness attained via the Land of Israel
tmp:2522: God's silence toward the sinner — the Holy One's forbearance (hecherashti, Ps. 50:21), which unlike human silence is not for Ehyeh but to reserve punishment for the World to Come
tmp:2523: receiving one's punishment in the World to Come — the deferred retribution that is the purpose of God's silence toward sinners
tmp:2524: subduing the material body (hakhna'at ha-chomer) — the soul "consuming the flesh" to unite the two inseparable companions (Chokhmah and Binah)
tmp:2525: shir — song/melody as such, the future song (simple-double-triple-quadruple) linked by wordplay to Sarah's rulership (sarah/shir)
tmp:2526: the simple-double-triple-quadruple song (shir pashut kaful meshulash meruba) — the future eschatological song of the fourfold expansion of God's Name, symbolized by the dalet of the letter Hei
tmp:2527: she-yesh dai b'Elokuti — Rashi's exposition of the divine Name Shaddai: 'there is enough in My Godliness for every creature,' tied to guarding the covenant
tmp:2528: hosting a Torah-scholar guest (hakhnasat orach talmid-chakham) — the act of receiving a sage as guest, remedying one's bad prayers
tmp:2529: total nullification of the body as nothing (bittul ha-guf) — speaking Torah and prayer until the body becomes naught, 'one flesh' unified with speech
tmp:2530: the verse-phrase 'cherpah shavrah libbi' — 'disgrace has broken my heart' (Ps. 69:21), disgrace identified as the aspect of forgetfulness
tmp:2532: the Supernal Land (eretz ha-elyonah) — the upper 'earth' identified with the Shekhinah, God's indwelling Presence
tmp:2533: learning Torah 'for the Shekhinah' — the elevated mode of study whereby one's learning ascends to the Shekhinah, the intermediary between humans and God
tmp:2534: shulchan — the table, associated with intellect (sekhel via shikkul wordplay) and the deeds of charity that perfect the mind
tmp:2535: the very great and lofty intellect (sekhel gadol ve-gavoah) — the supreme Da'at of Shavuot, which is supernal kindness and great compassion (God as merciful elder at Sinai)
tmp:2536: sone betza — hating unjust gain: despising money with utmost hatred, from the side of Malkhut, prerequisite for attaining the lower intellect
tmp:2537: hakdamot — preliminary premises/introductions, the preparatory steps of reasoning constituting the lower intellect that precedes the higher
tmp:2538: sa'ara ukama — 'black hair' (Zoharic term), symbol of the lower intellect from the side of Malkhut
tmp:2539: the supernal intellect and Da'at (sekhel ve-da'at elyon) — the fiftieth gate of Binah, the mikveh of Shavuot
tmp:2540: not distinguishing between kindness (chesed) and judgment (din) — the unification of chasadim and gevurot that constitutes true Da'at, blessing 'ha-tov ve-hameitiv' on all
tmp:2541: fasting or Shabbat eating — either practice alone as sufficient means to nullify and subdue one's enemies (vs. charity for abundant peace)
tmp:2542: nullifying and subduing the enemies (bittul ve-hakhna'at ha-oyvim) — the defeat of one's foes achieved through fasting or Shabbat eating
tmp:2543: the heart's flame ascending continually of itself (shalhevet ha-lev olah me-eleha) — the spontaneous rising fervor of the heart born from the intellect's motion
tmp:2544: tzedakah la-aniyim — charity given to the poor, as in 'sun on Shabbat is charity for the poor' (Ta'anit 8b), increasing peace
tmp:2545: Yaakov (Jacob) the patriarch as the embodiment of he'arat panim — the illumination of the face (his beauty like Adam's), the source of peace
tmp:2546: he'arat panim / hadrat panim — illumination and splendor of the divine countenance, the shining face that is the prerequisite for peace
